lines.para: 1. Shortwave radio. At set times, Moscow broadcasts strings of numbers, in Morse or read out by a monotonous voice. Only whoever holds the right grid can understand them.
2. The one-time pad. Each page is used once, then burned. Used properly, this code is impossible to break.
3. The dead drop. A hollow stone, a hole in a tree, the underside of a bench: one agent leaves a message for another to collect. The two agents never meet.
4. The hollow coin. In 1953, in New York, a young newspaper boy drops a five-cent coin that splits in two: inside, a microfilm. It will take the FBI four years to trace its owner.
